title: IPLD roundtrip tests use same codec for encode and decode (no independent oracle)
description: core/ipld/mime.rs:68-74, root_node.rs:111-124, builder.rs:167-193: serde_ipld_dagcbor used for both serialization and deserialization in roundtrip tests. A systematic codec bug (e.g., wrong field encoding in both directions) passes these tests while silently producing CIDs incompatible with external IPLD tooling. The test_vectors.rs vectors were cross-validated against Python dag-cbor — those are correct. The roundtrip tests provide no additional correctness guarantee. Fix: add byte-level assertions against the test_vectors.rs known-good hex, or cross-check with an independent library in the test.
